notes.title: Dev Log #10: July.2025
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! 
This is the FromDawn Games team coming at you with Volume 10 of the Aeruta developer’s log!

The weather this July has been… intense.
If we’re not being toasted like burnt toast under the blazing sun, we’re getting completely soaked by sudden typhoons and torrential rain. The air is humid and sticky, and just walking a few steps feels like stepping out of a steamer… 💦

Amidst this hot and hectic month, we’ve reached a major milestone — 
the successful completion of our Rapier Playtest! 🎉

A huge thank you to all the players who joined in. 
Your feedback has been incredibly valuable and will help us refine the rapier 
so that it shines with style in the full release ⚔️✨

In this dev diary, we’ll give you a peek at our latest progress and reveal some (possibly thrilling?) new content.

And of course! We'll wrap up with the promised Q&A section to answer your burning questions!
Let’s take a look together~ 📸✨
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*][h3][b]Entering the Forbidden Zone: Unveiling the Truth...[/b][/h3]
A once-bustling town now lies in ruins.
As you delve deeper into the remains, the scenery shifts from lush greenery to landscapes corroded by decay.

What kind of catastrophe befell this forbidden land? What fate does it reveal?
Perhaps what lies ahead is a story of regret, forgotten pain, and intertwining destinies...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/09d53a166f8e0c1f620701aa2e75d640bdba1e05.jpg[/img]
[*][h3][b]Chilala's Major Breakthrough: A Brand-New Badge Appears! 💗[/b][/h3]
After rigorous testing and countless tweaks, Chilala has finally broken through her limits and crafted a brand-new, powerful badge!

Whether you're a brave brawler or a tactical controller, you’ll find new ways to build your playstyle.

Experiment freely and create a combat style all your own!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/65f908b7a30f997db44c0dae3a577b7e99ede1fc.jpg[/img]
[*][h3][b]More Inventions!? The Genius Researcher Returns! ✨[/b][/h3]
The genius Chilala, once a sensation at the capital’s academy, is back with her wild creativity! 💥

This time, she’s applying a brand-new concept to weapons themselves…
Yes — a whole new system is quietly taking shape!
(Please kindly ignore that suspicious-looking contraption for now…)

This system is still under development, but we hope it brings new surprises to your adventure. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/ae15ad00780dedd2b02a5379276383e3402986eb.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h3][b]Q&A – Round Two [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Q1：The Rapier Playtest was fun! Will there be a chance to try other bosses?[/b]

Thanks for the love! Unfortunately, the Rapier Playtest has officially wrapped up ⚔️
But our next test will be a bigger build, with much more content — stay tuned!

[*] [b]Q2：Some badges feel too powerful. Will they be adjusted?[/b]

Absolutely! We’re reviewing all the feedback and will be tuning the stats for badges and weapons.
We aim to make every playstyle fun, balanced, and full of variety!

[*][b] Q3： Will the Watersong minigame get new tracks?[/b]

We never expected the minigame to be such a hit! 😳

While our current focus is still on the main game’s development, 
we’ll seriously consider updating tracks or even adding new minigames in the future!

[*] [b]Q4：Is the "teacher" mentioned by Kocori and Tyreenss actually Effie's ancestor?[/b]

Very sharp guess — yes!
Here’s a little secret: Effie's tribe is the last surviving clan of white bears on the continent… and deeply tied to past events…

[*] [b]Q5：Will there be more new characters?[/b]

Definitely! We’re also adding quirky side characters, like the mysterious unseen postman, a powerful guild leader, and... ◯◯◯◯◯（secret for now 👀）
[/list][hr][/hr]
That wraps up this month’s dev diary!
Answering your questions was a blast — many of your perspectives were ones we hadn’t considered, and the whole team felt inspired! 😲✨

We’ve also received many questions about the full release.
While there’s still a ways to go, we’ve started our first phase of testing and are steadily moving forward.
Maybe once the summer heat dies down a bit, we’ll be ready for the next Playtest, bringing us even closer to launch! 💪

Finally, thank you again to everyone who participated in the Rapier Playtest!
We received tons of helpful survey responses — many players mentioned concerns about control complexity, unclear descriptions, and overall balance…
Don’t worry, we’re already working on these improvements! 💪🦊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/9962b208f03a89588c95a94efff61a085924d0cb.jpg[/img]
Please hang in there a bit longer — we’ll keep baking up the best breadventure yet! 🍞

That’s all for the tenth development diary. 
See you all next month! 🦊💨

notes.title: Aeruta is having a Steam Playtest for a limited time this day!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
This is the Aeruta Team.

Thank you for always supporting Aeruta.

[u][b]As of today, the Steam Playtest has officially begun![/b][/u]

During this event, you will be able to test part of the new weapon “Rapier,” which is planned to be added in the full release.

We are still working hard on developing the full version, so this test build is not yet fully balanced and some features are incomplete.

You may also encounter bugs during gameplay, and we kindly ask for your understanding and feedback.

If you have any questions, bug reports, or thoughts while playing,
we would greatly appreciate it if you could share them with us through the survey below or join our Discord!

Please note that this test is limited to content related to [b]the “Rapier” only, and does not include bakery management, story, or other systems.[/b]

If you would like to experience the full game content of Aeruta,
we welcome you to download the official demo or purchase the Early Access version.

Check below for further details.
==========================
[h3][b]◆ Duration[/b][/h3]
July 21st, 2025 08:00 PM – July 28th, 2025 08:00 PM PDT

[h3][b]How to Participate[/b][/h3]
This test will be conducted using Steam’s Playtest feature.
To join:
[olist]
[*] Search for Aeruta in the Steam store,
or click here to go directly to the Steam store page:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2286780/"][/dynamiclink]
[*] Click the green “Request Access” button under “Join Aeruta Playtest.”
[*] Once confirmed, you will be able to access the test build.
[/olist]
[h3][b] Regarding Save Data[/b][/h3]
This test build is a separate special version. Progress in this test will [b]not carry over[/b] to the full release.

[h3][b]Steam Play Test Contents[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Chaya’s mission stage “2-1 Fruity Suburb”
[*] New weapon: Rapier
[*] Rapier’s skill tree
[/list]
[h3][b]◆ Disclaimer[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The duration of this test may be changed or cancelled without prior notice due to various reasons.
[*] This is a version of the game currently under development and does not guarantee the most comfortable version of the gaming experience.
[*] During test play, unexpected behaviors or issues may occur for which we do not provide support.
[*] If there are any serious issues or adjustments that need to be made, we may update the software during the test play period.
[/list]

[h3][b]Survey Participation[/b][/h3]
To make Aeruta even better, we would greatly appreciate it if you could fill out our survey!
Your valuable feedback helps us improve and bake the best bread possible 🦊🍞

[h3]Access the survey 
[url=https://forms.gle/n6f7vxPCCFso2mQ46]here[/url][/h3]

[h3][b]Regarding Streaming and Video Posting of Aeruta[/b][/h3]
We welcome all players to freely stream and post videos of Aeruta.
We hope you will enjoy this adventure together with your viewers and fans 🦊🍞

If you plan to livestream or upload videos on video platforms, please note:
There are no restrictions on streaming or posting videos of this test version or the full version.

However, please be aware that the test version and Early Access version may differ in certain aspects.
If possible, please indicate this in your video description, such as: “This stream is from the Steam Playtest version.”

Once again, we would like to express our sincere thanks to all of you who have supported us so far. We are currently developing fully implement the update, so please stay tuned!

Thank you for reading until the end, we hope that you’ll continue to support Aeruta.

notes.title: Dev Log #7: Apr.2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
This is the FromDawn Games team🔆

Welcome to the latest developer’s log for Aeruta!

What does April mean? 🌸
Rising temperatures, allergy season... and also our studio’s birthday month! 🍞🎉
This year, we kept developing as usual—and also kept exploding (figuratively… or maybe literally?).
We’ve poured all that joy, chaos, and caffeine into this devlog!

In this issue: nonstop explosive adventures (literally), perilous ruins to explore, a new culinary breakthrough from Effie,
and—Chaya’s life-changing moment!? 😲⁉️

Don’t miss it—let’s dive in!

[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*][h3][b]Boom Boom Boom! A New Adventure on new Island is in the Works… 💥[/b][/h3]
Suddenly—BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! Explosions echo through the ruins. 
Walls crumble, dust flies, and somewhere in the chaos—Chaya’s scream!?
Did Chaya accidentally blow something up again!? 🤯

That’s right—we’ve begun designing the third island’s stages!
With a step-up in difficulty, tougher enemies, more thrilling challenges, and huge, explosive scenes,
get your rolling pin ready—it’s time for an explosive adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/b275f127dedc565c18a5ccf23f48591f46a68686.jpg[/img]

[*][h3][b]Full of Traps and Perils—Can Chaya Make It Out Alive?[/b][/h3]
Every step Chaya takes could trigger danger… ⚠️🚨

Stay sharp and move precisely. 
Observe the remnants left by those who came before—you might just find a safe path.

Overcome each trap, conserve your strength, and prepare to face the mastermind lurking in the shadows!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/3d4ae73d7b74920ce6b4e315d470c40012dc773d.jpg[/img]

[*][h3][b]New Ingredients, New Recipes—Fresh Bread from Effie’s Kitchen! ✨[/b][/h3]
The moment Effie laid eyes on the mysterious ingredients Chaya brought back from the ruins, inspiration struck!

Fizzy sausage pie soaked in OOOO, salad buns made with XXXX, 
and cube cakes that taste like △△△△—
Chaya had no idea what any of it meant, but looking at the disaster in the kitchen, she knew…
she’d be sweeping the floor for a long time again today 🦊💦

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/5404aae602a7035198718d9702ee21f8a8486ace.jpg[/img]

[*][h3][b]Main Story Progresses—Is Chaya’s Intern Hero Journey Coming to an End!?[/b][/h3]
Who stole the Aeruta crystal? And for what reason?
Where did this conspiracy begin—and will Chaya finally become a full-fledged hero…? ⚔️

Mysteries deepen, choices grow heavier—and yes, emotions heat up too!
The main story, side quests, and affection events are now fully written—
Chaya’s path as a hero is yours to uncover! 🎮👀
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

April marks the founding of our studio—that’s right, we’re two years old now! 🎂🥳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/f4c4f11be5f36e9b1950c26e2a5dc4c321c42d2d.jpg[/img]

On April 17, 2023, we started from a tiny studio, driven by the simple belief of making games we ourselves would love to play.
We stumbled a lot along the way—but we kept moving forward.

Two years later, we’re still going strong—coding, fixing bugs, designing levels, drawing more art…
The only interruption? Watching a 15-minute preview of Mario Kart World together—
and ending the day sulking about not landing a SWITCH 2 preorder.

🎈 But what started as an ordinary day turned magical thanks to your birthday wishes! 🎉
Every message, reply, share, and review on Steam—we read them all, and they truly mean the world to us.
It’s amazing to see this space grow into a cozy home for passionate devs like us—and for players like you 💕

By the way—that mysterious new system on the roadmap? 
Development has already begun!
It’s a little surprise we can’t reveal just yet… but we hope you’ll get to see it soon ✨

That wraps up our seventh devlog. 
See you next time!

notes.title: Dev Log #6: Mar.2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
This is the FromDawn Games team🔆

Welcome to the latest developer’s log for Aeruta!

As spring blossoms, this month's minor update brings a fresh atmosphere to Bakersfield—
our two goddesses, Kocori and Tyreenss, have finally arrived, officially joining the bakery!

As their bonds with everyone deepen, long-forgotten memories and secrets—gentle, sorrowful, 
or difficult to speak of—will gradually come to light... ✨

With that in mind, let's dive into this month's development progress!
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*] [h3][b] Gifts of the Ruins—New Bread Recipes Are On the Way! 🍞🥞🥐[/b][/h3]
On the third island, ancient ruins stretch across the land, preserving traces of past civilizations. 

But beyond history, these ruins are also home to a unique ecosystem filled with rare ingredients—fragrant, rich, and exotic!

And what’s better than rare, high-quality ingredients? 
A skilled baker who can turn them into delicious new creations!

Help Effie gather these precious materials! New ingredients and new bread are coming soon—
stay tuned! 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/1c4c637e3f600c7b79393dbe0f2b5ac3a2dccd29.jpg[/img]
[*] [h3][b]The Mysterious Horned Rescuer—A New Goddess?[/b][/h3]
The enigmatic ruins are filled with danger. 
Even the most seasoned adventurers find them challenging to conquer.

Yet strangely, no adventurer has ever perished there—
because whenever they fall into danger, they miraculously reappear at the entrance.

No one has ever seen the rescuer’s true form, but rumors say they have long horns and are always accompanied by an ancient book…
Could these clues point to one of the three goddesses from the Chaos War—the legendary hero, "OOOO"? 💚

Is this long-lost hero and the mysterious rescuer the same person?
No one knows for sure, but adventurers love to speculate about the truth behind this legend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/9aebc1930be7115ee430b921d8e25d0eb7a5bbbb.jpg[/img]
[*][h3][b] A Bakery Reborn—Bigger, Better, Stronger! 💥[/b][/h3]
Do you remember Chaya’s explosive entrance when she first arrived?
Thanks to Bollio’s careful repairs (and all the money you’ve invested), Effie’s bakery is finally back to its original glory!

But why stop there? There’s always room for improvement!
Bollio has brought a brand-new catalog with adorable tables and chairs, elegant curtains, 
and high-performance ovens! 😲💕

Keep working hard to upgrade your bakery and save up for renovations! Let’s aim to become the world’s No.1 super bakery! 🏆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/a74045e176d86b34be436a522e918fdaab8bc27a.jpg[/img]
[*][h3][b]The Ultimate Mastery—Weapon Skills Phase 3 Incoming![/b][/h3]
That’s right—Weapon Skills Phase 3 is now complete!

In this new phase, whips, rolling pins, and rapiers will receive powerful enhancements!
Each weapon type will unlock its own exclusive third-stage upgrade—
Imagine XXXX soaring through the air, △△△△ striking from above, and □□□□ bursting with radiant colors!

We hope this expanded skill tree will bring even more thrilling combat experiences!
Get ready to harness new powers and take on even greater challenges! 👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/bbb3a14ba14871bdf253d84214c704b4ef3c7afd.jpg[/img]
[/list][hr][/hr]

Thank you all for your support, making the spring update rollout a success! 
Have you met the goddesses yet?

With the spring update now stable, we will continue refining the gameplay experience—fixing translation errors, adjusting level designs, and polishing details to further enhance the game.

At the same time, there won’t be any major changes following this spring update—
because we are now fully diving into the final development sprint for the full release of Aeruta🏃

Though there’s still some time before the official release, our team is steadily making progress.
With our spirits and determination burning strong, we’ll keep pushing forward! 💪🦊

Moving forward, we’ll continue sharing updates through these dev logs, bringing you the latest news.
With your support, Chaya’s adventure has come this far—let’s march toward the full release of Aeruta together! 🌼

See you in the next dev log!

notes.title: Dev Log #5: Feb.2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is the FromDawn Games team🔆

Welcome to the latest developer’s log for Aeruta!

After the holiday break, we jumped straight back into development, working on both the upcoming spring update and new content. We almost ran out of time to write the February dev log… 🙇💦

Thank you for your patience! Without further ado, let’s dive into this month’s progress!! 
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*] [h3][b]The Goddesses Have Arrived—Welcome to Bakersfield! 💙❤[/b][/h3]
Let’s give a warm round of applause (and some excited screams) for the hero among heroes—
our divine goddesses!

Kocori and Tyreenss have officially arrived in Bakersfield! 
(Though Kocori has been sneaking around for a while…)

The approachable and friendly Kocori, the cold yet dignified Tyreenss—how will they interact with the other residents? 
What kind of story will unfold between them and Chaya?

Find out in the March mini-update as you search for these divine figures in Bakersfield Plaza!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/e8943b187a721696cdddb60b42f998f173f332f8.jpg[/img] 
[*] [h3][b]In the Ancient Ruins Lies a Hidden Truth…[/b][/h3]
Let’s take a sneak peek at the development of contents for the full release!

Chaya's next adventure is to an ancient ruin abandoned long ago. 
Once a thriving city, it was tragically destroyed from war. 
Now moss, ivy, and mushrooms have overgrown and covered the walls and ground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/8d241fd070ecacabef4da395ad2f49557053581b.jpg[/img] 
Wait a second… did you hear that low growl in the wind…? 
Have these ruins truly been abandoned? 
Or is someone secretly watching intruders?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/1167a6822e3e4a9dff262e9b3bbef5ccd445f3d9.jpg[/img] 
[*][h3][b]New Weapon in Development: The Rapier![/b][/h3]
You’re not gonna want to miss this! Aspiring heroes, get ready to wield the third weapon—
the rapier! (We’re not stealing it, just borrowing!)

The rapier is a thin, razor-sharp blade as swift as the rising crescent moon and as elegant as the full moon’s glow. Designed for rapid thrusts and precision attacks, 

it’s the perfect weapon for those who want to push their speed and skill to the limit! ⚔️✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/5b3301712e5d530586e18f1bdc6048902552007d.jpg[/img] 
[*][h3][b]New Feature: Q&A Corner![/b][/h3]
We often see bug reports and questions from the community on social media and the Steam forums.

However, due to our workload and language limitations, we haven’t always been able to respond to everyone individually…

So! To better address your concerns, we’re launching a Q&A Corner! 

Here, we’ll compile and answer some of the most frequently asked questions:
[olist]
[*][b][u]Will there be an achievement system in the future?[/u][/b]
👉 Yes! Please look forward to it!
[*][b][u]Will there be additional stage modes?[/u][/b]
👉 Yes! New stage modes will be added in the full release. We hope you’ll look forward to it!
[*][b][u]The difficulty of Chapter 2 spikes suddenly—is this intentional?[/u][/b]
👉 We’ve adjusted some adventure stages and hope to improve this in the upcoming spring update!
[*][b][u]What species are the villagers introduced in the autumn update?[/u][/b]
👉 Guinea pigs! Most of them work under Tyreenss, though having a workaholic boss is… 
a bit stressful for them (lol)
[*][b][u]Will new songs be added to the rhythm game?[/u][/b]
👉 Our focus is currently on developing new content, but we’ll definitely consider it!
[/olist][/list]

Overwhelmingly, the question we received more than any other was: “When will the game officially release?”

At this time, we are still in the midst of development, so we don’t have a complete view of the development schedule just now.

We will keep you guys updated on the progress in our dev logs, so please look forward to further updates!

Phew~ that’s it for our Q&A Corner. We’ll continue updating it along with the dev logs, so stay tuned! 🌻

If you have any concerns or questions, please let us know in the dev log comments or in the comments on our social media!

Last but not least, looking back at January, we wrapped up the Taipei Game Show on a high note and returned from the New Year holidays refreshed and motivated.

Offline events like these are rare and valuable opportunities—not only do we get to hear your feedback firsthand, but we also get to witness players enjoying Aeruta in person. Some of you even visited us just to share your excitement about the game—it was truly an unforgettable experience! 🥺🧡

And as for the merchandise that many of you have been asking for… we want to make it too!
Bread-shaped sponges, Patti figurines, real-life bread replicas… Just imagining it all is so exciting!

But for now, ensuring Aeruta is at its best quality is our main goal! 🦊👍
So please wait a little bit longer for goods! ✨

That’s all for this issue of the Aeruta Dev Log! We’ll see you all again in March!

notes.title: Dev Log #4: Jan.2025
notes.content:
Hello everyon! This is the Aeruta development team🔆
Welcome to Vol. 4 of the official Aeruta dev log!

This might be a bit late, but Happy New Year to you all!🎉

With the start of a new year, development for Aeruta is progressing full steam ahead.
We’re currently working on a small spring update and the long-awaited official release!
(Wooho!!💥)


We’re juggling a lot at once, but we hope it’ll all turn out alright✨
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*] [h3][b]Spring update, goddesses’ stories🌸[/b][/h3]
Ahh, spring… new life is budding, the sun is gentle, the leaves are young and fragrant, and cherry blossoms are in full bloom.
It’s the perfect season to make friends!


During this picturesque season, we will implement friendship events with the friendly goddesses, who we all admire so much.
How did the cheerful and bright Kocori and the stern yet calm Tyreenss become goddesses?
Strengthen your bonds with them and all will be revealed!💙❤

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/39fbb7d039355c968493fe92151df1e760031f38.jpg[/img] 
[*] [h3][b]New area incoming! Our next destination is…[/b][/h3]
Following Chaya’s adventures in Merca and Orrindae, our hero will travel to the next stage: ancient and bustling ruins.
It will be a stage full of ●●●●●, ×××××, and plenty of △△△△△!
It’s sure to be a new and exciting experience, with even more dangers and delicious attractions! 

The whole team is currently hard at work designing all the new environments, enemies, and ingredients. We’re really looking forward to sharing it with all of you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/88b698a3929fdbb0168a4da22d72e9f734f9bed4.jpg[/img]
[*][h3][b]The 1st Character Popularity Ranking: Bakersfield Cup![/b][/h3]
During the Steam Playtest held November last year, we compiled and ranked your favorite characters from the survey🏆

So let’s take a look at who captured everyone's hearts in the 1st Character Popularity Ranking <Bakersfield Cup>!
🎉

🥉 3rd place: Chilala
Despite her late appearance in the game after the fall major update, her adorable appearance and remarkable genius (and numerous eccentricities) garnered her a lot of attention, rightfully earning her third place!
It seems many were charmed by this young genius!🎀

🥈 2nd place: Effie
You can't go on an adventure without a loaf of Effie’s bread!
The kid bear who always supports Chaya and friends in their adventures ranked second place!
Effie lost her parents when she was a small child, but inherited the family bakery. Thanks to her inner strength and natural cheerfulness, she diligently continues to research new bread recipes.
The warm loaves of bread she makes are as soft and comforting as hot cocoa with marshmallows on a winter day!☕️

🏆 1st place: Chaya
The winner is none other than the main character of our story, thanks to the overwhelming support of everyone who voted!
As a rookie adventurer she may be a little out of her element now and then, but her positive and kind nature as well as her courage in the face of difficulty proves her potential to be a hero (though she’s not quite there yet)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/8f3e268247b81dbb6f41bfdbf584a2baf976d3e5.png[/img]
Did your fav make the rankings?
Share your thoughts with us on SNS🌟
[/list]
We worked as hard as we could in 2024, and just like firewood in its final moments, we are officially “burn out.”
As such, we will be taking a week off for Lunar New Year 2025! (Hooray! 🎉)


But before that, we’ll get our whips and rolling pins ready,
because we’ll be exhibiting at the 2025 Taipei Game Show on January 23rd!🍞

We’ll be waiting for you at booth S04.
You can also pick up a free Hero Rolling Pin at the event! Be ready to take down Pattis any time!💥

Additionally, we will have a scale model of Effie’s bakery, handmade teddy bread... and many other surprises!
If you’re coming to the event, please visit our booth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/fd400bace24e7ed580dd261afa59fc45e8954a44.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/7f619451dd3f669c7549cf30a932dea1cabda0af.jpg[/img]

Time sure flies when you’re having fun…
This wraps up Volume 4 of the Aeruta dev log!
After a short break, a small spring update is just around the corner! Please look forward to it!
🦊

notes.title: Dev Log #3: Dec.2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is the Aeruta development team🔆
Welcome to Volume 3 of the Aeruta Dev Log!

Following the Fall Major Update in November, have you all gotten into the “rhythm” of kneading bread dough? 🥖

Just as we sow seeds in the spring and harvest them in the fall, we had finally reached the time to welcome our first major update, exactly six months after releasing early access!

Sorry for the long wait, but how about we take a quick look back at everything the fall update 
brought us🍁
[hr][/hr]
[h3]◾ Holding a Steam Playtest before the official Fall Major Update![/h3]
Prior to the big update, we held a Steam Playtest for three days to collect all your valuable feedback.
We were overjoyed to receive a total of 114 completed surveys!

These surveys were filled with valuable opinions, creative ideas, tons of encouragement, 
and most importantly, real impressions of the gameplay experience. 
Some of you gave us such in-depth analysis it was like reading a graduation thesis 📝

Additionally, many people actively shared bug reports and insights on Discord. 
It was thanks to the help of all of these people that we were able to make our Fall Major Update 
even better! ✨

We had also received some feedback that the Playtest was too short! We’d like to let you all know we’re sorry for that and we’ll be more considerate next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/2d43ae04c7ed343b2d847b732d8252e866217737.jpg[/img]
[h3]◾ As the harvest season begins, a major update is ready🍁 [/h3]
Looking back, we are amazed at the incredible reception of the update😲
Following the update, the total number of reviews we received from you on Steam exceeded 350 
and the “Recent Reviews” reached 98%, so we are very happy that so many of you enjoyed the update!

To celebrate this delightful achievement, we held a big celebration in the studio, ordering fried chicken for the whole team for the first time in a long time 🍗✨

Let's take a look at all the wonderful things that happened, shall we!

🦊 Maintained user ratings at “Very Positive” and increased the favorability rate from 87% to 89%
🦊 More than 400 people added Teddy Bread to their wish list every day
🦊 Over 600 people were fighting to pay off their debt in Bakersfield daily

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/a4faaeae965f4abebe3e7c141a1ef1a43101604a.jpg[/img]
[h3]◾ Further changes based on your feedback![/h3]
In addition to the planned contents such as the second island, new characters, 
and raising the level cap for various systems, we made various changes based on your feedback 
in this update.

Here’s an overview of the changes we made!

🍞 NPC elements (additional conversation variations, gifts, friendship system, meeting characters during adventures)
🍞 Added “Patti Defense Battle,” a stage great for collecting lots of patti dough!
🍞 Addition of icon to notify completion of skill cooldowns
🍞 Addition of numerical display of materials in your possession in the stage selection map UI
🍞 Added window resolution options for various ratios

Besides this, many other design adjustments and improvements were also made thanks to your valuable feedback.

Thank you all so much! 🌏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/087da1ae4f8ac2e2bf4cb89586b18a7cc3521361.jpg[/img]
[h3]◾ Development plans for 2025 are now available![/h3]
Following the adventures on the second island, even more trials await on Chaya’s road to heroism…
The Aeruta Crystal has been stolen by a mysterious black mist, and the Adventurer's Guild has a conflict with the goddesses.

Will Chaya successfully pass the Adventurer’s test and graduate from being a rookie adventurer?

💥[b] All will be revealed come 2025! [/b]💥.

Around next spring, we plan to add friendship events for the goddesses! Get ready to conquer their hearts! 

And what’s more, we plan to implement a third island by the end of 2025. 
Not only will a third weapon option be made available, but a very interesting system is also 
in the works…

There’s so much to look forward to✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/59a3d831b014cdd3b6d0523c122a0230df687351.jpg[/img]
November was full of busy days preparing for the major update, so unfortunately the development diary took a temporary break... but during this period, preparations were well underway behind the scenes!
When it finally comes time to pick up the pen, it's pretty hard to know where to start talking, though.

We wanted to share with you all the feelings of joy and gratitude we’ve felt, behind-the-scenes development stories, trivia, our personal thoughts on Aeruta, and answer some of your survey questions…

We really had so much more we wanted to tell you, but we’ll be sharing even more in the future🌻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/7ea9a601da15954f11e5207691eb4b815f6776b3.jpg[/img]
With the little bit of 2024 that remains, a few weeks ago we took our rolling pins to the G-eight gaming exhibition in Taiwan. There was an adventurer at the event who breathed a sigh of relief after defeating Birdy Captain then turned to us and said, “I've been so busy with work before New Year's Eve I haven't had time to play the updated content at all...'

Thank you all so much for your hard work TT…
Effie's Bakery will always be here for you!

May 2025 be a year filled with strength, willpower, and good luck for all of you! ✨
We will continue to improve on our shortcomings and produce an even better game, so look forward to more surprises in the future!

Let's do our best together in the new year! 🦊🍞

notes.title: Aeruta Early Access Ver.0.2.1 Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for playing the Early Access version of Aeruta.
Today at 18:00 (JST) the game has been updated to the latest version.

The contents of the update are as follows:

[h2]■12/17/2024Ver.0.2.1 Patch Note[/h2]
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] A record player has been added to the second floor of the bakery. Rhythm games can be re-played here.
[*]  A new song “Merca Forest” was added to the rhythm game.
[*] Ten new stages have been added to the second island.
[*] When selecting a map, the number of materials available in that map are now displayed.
[*] When developing the village or renovating the bakery, the effect of the next level is now displayed.
[*] Bakery helpers now clean up trash. (So helpful!)
[*] A button to cancel checkout is now displayed when you're running the bakery.
[/list]
[h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] The effect of the village facility “streetlight” has been enhanced. It further improves the patience of customers.
[*] Each facility in the village that increases the number of customer visits has been modified to also increase the maximum waiting line for checkout.
[*] Changed the quantity of gifts required when raising the likelihood of a fellow member to raise NPC friendship levels.
[*] The effect of the additional ability of the rolling pin, “Passive Chaos,” was changed so that it is activated one second after the dough reaches the maximum limit.
[*] The additional ability “Secondary Target”  speed at which the rolling pin flies toward the enemy has been slowed.
[*] Changed the size of the skill “Rolling Pin Cyclone” so that when the “Enticing Aroma ” additional ability is used it attracts even more enemies
[*] The limit for accumulating dough for the drive skill when attacking multiple monsters with the “Rolling Pin Cyclone” skill has been changed to 10 doughs.
[*] The whip skill “Spiral Leap” has been changed so that it can attack downward even if you have not learned the additional ability “Blossom Whirl” (so strong!)
[*] The cooldown time reduction effect of the badge “Stabby Crab's Instinctive Dodge” has been fixed at 3.5 seconds.
[*] The damage reduction rate for the badge “Summer Clam's Sudden Insight” has been changed from 3% to 2.5% and the maximum reduction rate from 75% to 50%.
[*] The number of times thorn balls can be reflected with the badge “Shooty Crab's Rolling Spikes” has been changed to unlimited, and the maximum number of hits to the same target has been adjusted from one to three to reduce the speed.
[*] A cooldown (3 seconds) has been added to the HP recovery effect of the badge “Bonkfish's Sonic Wave.”
[*] The effect of the badge “Ponkfish's Inspiration” has been changed so that the shield is no longer earned when a patti tribe is defeated.
[*] In the main quest “Save Tyreenss,” the quantity of each material required for progress has been changed.
[*] Wood: From 5 pieces to [b]50[/b] pieces.
[*] Ponkfruit: From 3 pieces to [b]10[/b] pieces.
[*] Patti dough: From 100 pieces to [b]300[/b] pieces.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented some monsters from attacking Chaya in certain circumstances.
[*] Fixed an issue where the gift would disappear if the screen was quickly closed when a gift was given.
[*] Fixed a problem in which the position of the “Chilala's Genius Lab” was incorrect when the building was completed.
[*] Fixed a problem in which the effect of the badge “Stabby Crab's Sideways Movement” was not activating correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the damage of the badge “Shooty Crab's Rolling Spikes” was higher than expected.
[*] Fixed an issue where after the boss “Patti King” splits in two, if the left side “King Patty” was knocked down during the fall, the right side “Patti King” would not move.
[/list]

Aeruta will continue to improve and modify existing content and tweak new content based on your comments.
We look forward to all your honest feedback.

Thank you for your continued support of Aeruta.

notes.title: Aeruta Early Access Ver.0.2.0 f1 Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for always supporting Aeruta.
We'd like to extend a special thank you to everyone who immediately played the major update that launched last week.

This particular update focuses on bug fixes and balance adjustments for the newly added content, as well as improving some existing content.

Read below for the details.

[h2]■11/26/2024　Ver.0.2.0 f1 Patch Note[/h2]
[h3]New Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Daily Bonus labels are now also displayed on the Bread Research screen.
[*] If a new conversation is available on the character conversation screen, a "?" mark will be displayed. If a conversation that would increase the character's friendship points is available a "!" will be displayed.
[*] Adjusted Chilala's position as long as "Chilala's Genius Lab" has not been constructed.
[*] Added a label of the game version being played to the upper right corner of the screen.
[/list]
[h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] The amount of HP recovery from consuming Snowman Dumplings has been adjusted from 100% to 75%
[*] The effects of Blossom Mochi has been changed to "HP is decreased by 4.5% every 10 seconds and converted into a 6% shield."
[*] Selling price of bread at closing time has been changed from 50% to 75%.
[*] The number of regular materials required for badge production was changed from 30 to 20.
[*] The Baker Popularity level required to unlock Floral Maze was changed from 100 to 175.
[*] The Baker Popularity level required to unlock Iris Fortress was changed from 175 to 250.
[*] Increased the HP of Floral Emissary Visser by 10% and changed the attack pattern when she reaches low HP.
[*] Increased the HP of Blazing Flower Goddess Tyreenss by 7% and increased some of her attack damage.
[*] The number of customers visiting during bakery operations was adjusted. The overall number of customer visits now increases relative to the number of loaves of bread being sold.
[*] Adjusted the effect of the rolling pin's additional skill "Passive Chaos" so that it only activates when there is an enemy on the screen and will not target the air.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Effie's Gloves would not function properly.
[*] Fixed a problem with the upgraded Lv2 Inn not displaying properly.
[*] Fixed a problem with text not being displayed on the lower right enhancement button of the Skill Tree.
[*] Fixed an error where a helper was not displayed correctly when selecting a helper for bakery management.
[*] Fixed a problem that caused some items to drop in abnormally large quantities when using the Bread Energy "Harvest Prayer."
[*] Fixed an issue with incorrect drop probability of bread appearing with the "Not Alone" skill in the Skill Tree.
[*] Fixed an issue with the badge "Stabby Crab's Sideways Movement" not activating correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the attack of the spotted garden eels would not play in Merca Temple.
[*] Fixed an occasional lag when text is displayed at the top of the screen.
[*] When using a controller, only certain buttons could be used to advance dialog after giving a gift.
[*] Fixed a problem in which some number values were not displayed correctly in languages that use "," as decimal points.
[*] Fixed some translation, UI, and other issues.
[/list]
Last but not least, we hope you will continue to provide us your valuable feedback to help make Aeruta an even better game! 

We appreciate all your continued support of Aeruta!

[*] Adjusted the balancing for various skills of both the whip and rolling pin.

[*] Adjusted the hit detection border for the water pillars.
[*] Adjusted speed when getting off platforms.
[*] When using Bread Energy to revive, one additional loaf of bread is replenished.
[*] Adjusted base crit rate and critical damage.[/list]

[h3]UI Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Materials not yet acquired on the adventure preparation screen are now indicated with a grayed out "?"
[*] Added coin icons onto the Training screen.
[*] Added a numerical display of Chaya's HP.
[*] Adjusted the way buffs are displayed. Important ones are now displayed above Chaya's head, while others are displayed below the HP bar.
[*] Improved calendar display: days of the week added. Days Monday to Saturday are shown, but not Sunday.
[*] Adjusted audio sound effects of obstacles: it should not play when moving between stages.
[*] Audio of off-screen traps has been made less choppy.
[*] Improved visibility of high rarity materials.[/list]


[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused villagers to take off their hats when going out.
[*] Fixed interaction bugs.
[*] Fixed a bug that unintentionally increased the damage of certain skills.
[*] Many other minor bugs were fixed!

notes.title: Dev Log #2: Oct.2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is the Aeruta Development Team 🔆

Welcome back to another edition of the Aeruta Dev Log!

The first edition received even better feedback than we expected. 
We carefully read every comment and felt greatly encouraged by them. Thank you all!💪

How has everyone been lately?

The weather in Taiwan is gradually cooling down, and the sun sets earlier. 
As October comes to an end... the much-anticipated “Free Autumn Major Update" is almost here!

Without further ado, let's preview some of the updates coming your way→
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*] [h3][b]Customize Your Adventure! The Badge System Shines Bright![/b][/h3]
Chaya's Hero Code Rule 3: "The three things a hero can't be without on their journey: weapons, bread, and 'badges'!"

Starting with the Autumn update, players will be able to choose different badges to take on their adventures⚔️.

Badges are divided into three main types: "Offensive," "Defensive," and "Function." 
This update introduces about 20 badges, each with its own adventure-boosting effects. 

Get ready to find your path as a hero!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/ba8510ddb3f3113c97964f993ee7eae795fd0ba9.jpg[/img]
[*] [h3][b]Unexpected Discoveries During Adventures!?[/b][/h3]
In addition to the usual adventure and resource stages, the adventure map now features even more surprises!

You might find treasure chests, a lone-standing Effie, and... even more Pattis? 
With all there is to enjoy, before you know it you’ll find yourself at the boss stage!

Besides this, you can now plan your outings with the calendar! Who doesn't love getting things done more efficiently?
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/61ad863938a1567aa6a1a95c8b986e3dd3179bd0.jpg[/img]
[*][h3][b]Call in Friends to Help the Bakery![/b][/h3]
Our hero may have accidentally blown-up a bakery to smithereens... 
but the debt that she’s in must NOT be discovered by the Guild!

So let’s get it payed back A.S.A.P💥 Why not invite some friends to lend a helping hand?
Let’s put all their talents to use, attract more customers, boost sales, 
and create even more business opportunities!

All you have to do to recruit them is strike up a pleasant conversation💬

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/f097a78b36ad2d20948d4b231af3e513299a7090.jpg[/img] 
[*] [h3][b]Bakersfield is Getting a Major Upgrade! New Decor, New Bonuses... and New Faces![/b][/h3]
As the reputation of Effie's bakery grows, the tourism industry in Bakersfield is also getting a boost... so it’s about time to renovate the buildings!

Let’s take a look at the new catalog meticulously prepared by Bollio.

This time around, besides enhancing existing structures, 
Bollio also has plans to build a hotel for travelers to rest in (after all, a good rest might have them feeling more generous), a faster checkout counter for Chaya, and an Extendable Grabber made from scraps. 

Oh…? What’s this? The last page of the catalog mentions something about a " Cosmic Curios" and a "Genius Scientist Chilala"?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/e2404c4f2b74b4ccd126b7e274029d24d87a076f.jpg[/img] 
That's right, even more new friends are coming to Bakersfield!
What kind of personalities will these new friends have? Let's give them a warm welcome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43525165/25d6955bf42829bf2cc1a606296c030bc0153371.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
And that’s the end of our second dev log! Which new content are you most looking forward to?
This major update adds many mechanics to enrich the gameplay of "Aeruta" and deepens its world!

Unfortunately, due to the size of updates, we can't introduce everything all at once—but we’re certain that "Aeruta" is getting closer and closer to the game we envision. 
We hope you'll enjoy the direction that this update takes. If you have any suggestions or feedback, 
feel free to share them with us anytime.

In the coming weeks, more game content will be gradually revealed across Aeruta’s communities, 
and we've prepared some gifts for you. We hope the aroma of bread will accompany you through 
the end of 2024✨.

Thanks for reading to the end!

We’re looking forward to all that’s to come in November🦊🍞
Please look forward to the free Autumn major update of "Aeruta — A Bread Adventure Sweeping the World.”

notes.title: Aeruta Early Access Ver. 0.1.3 Update Announcement!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for enjoying the Early Access version of Aeruta. We are very grateful for the many opinions and requests you have sent us. Based on your feedback, we have updated the game to version 0.1.3.

[h2]■ Patch Notes for 2024/07/04[/h2]
[h3]Game System Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game file has been updated to a 64-bit file and the minimum system requirements have been reduced.
[/list]
[h3]New Game Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]The altar in front of the bakery starts to glow with the aroma of delicious bread! By using the accumulated "Bread Energy" created from running the bakery, you can obtain a variety of effects to help you in your adventure.
[*]The Water Song obstacle course mini-game can be replayed by interacting with the trophy displayed in your room!
[*]A side quest has been added for Chiva. This will allow you to start training earlier than before. If the save data you've been playing has already past the timing for the quest to occur, the quest will be added to your save data automatically.
[*]Added a vibration setting to the controller, it will shake or not shake depending on your preference!
[*]New outfits for villagers have been added, and more outfits planned for the future! Stay tuned!
[*]Added more villager conversation variations, a hint will be indicated for conversations that have not been read yet.
[*]Drop rate for boss materials have been increased (hooray!!)
[*]Skills with cooldown will now be displayed with a numerical value representing the cool down speed.
[*]Monster shadows are now only displayed on the ground the same as Chaya.
[*]More hints are now indicated for when a quest or conversation is available.
[*]Timer reduces when the wrong direction is input during checkout.
[*]Total amount of damage inflicted is now shown below the combo display. This display can be turned off from the Settings menu by selecting "Show Damage Figures".
[*]Text size increased in most UI since it was difficult to see on the Steam Deck.
[*]Adjustments to the camera perspective at Merca Shrine.
[/list]

[h3]Battle Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*]The Water Pillar attack has been adjusted to have flashier effects!
[*]The stopping effect of a successful evasion has been improved.
[*]When monsters attack they fall to the ground quickly rather than staying suspended in the air.
[*]Skill activation and bread-eating actions are no longer interruptible.
[*] Increased the amount of dough gained when the weapon skill: Bear's Wrath is used.
[*]Increased recovery amount for all breads (hooray!)
[*]The damage, cooldown, and level-up effect values of some skills has been changed. Some skill's damage and other effects are enhanced when leveling up.
[*] The effect of the weapon skill: Fearless Assault has been revised so that the lower the HP, the more damage dealt (so strong!)
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem where the display of coins earned when bakery management was finished did not match the actual value (Effie's accounting has improved!)
[*]Fixed a problem with the main quest displaying the wrong description.
[*]Fixed a problem where a a character would continue asking for help even after the quest had been granted.
[*]Fixed a problem where a characters speech bubble was overlapping the interaction hints.
[*]Fixed a problem where enemies fall quickly after being attacked by the skill: Floral Finale.
[*]Fixed an problem where bread would be displayed with a Sold Out sign too early under certain conditions.
[*]Fixed a problem with blurry backgrounds during building upgrades.
[*]Fixed a problem where Bollio would not stop expressing their happiness after a building upgrade was completed.
[*]Fixed an problem where the drop rate of Patti dough was not affected by the Luck status.
[*]Fixed a problem that caused an invalid falling motion at the boundary between a platform and the ground
[*]Fixed a problem where coins did not change when skills are reset.
[*] Fixed a problem where quickly selecting [Cancel] to open the interface during a manual save would cause the game to freeze.
[/list]

As always we would like to express our deepest gratitude to everyone supporting Aeruta. During the Early Access period, we will continue improving and adjusting existing content and new content based on your feedback. We welcome your honest opinions.

We hope you'll continue to support and make Aeruta the best game possible!

notes.title: Aeruta Early Access Ver 0.1.2 & Demo Version Update Announcement!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for enjoying the early access version of Aeruta. We also appreciate the many opinions and requests you have sent us. Based on your feedback, we have updated it to version 0.1.2.

This update primarily focuses on improving the early game experience and balancing the casual mode. In addition to updating the early access version, we've also updated the demo as well! In the demo update, we added save and transfer features and adjusted the game balance and localization to match the early access version.

[list]
[*] Adjusted the skill tree screen to allow resetting acquired skills using coins.
[*] Added a preview function for each skill in the skill tree screen.
[*] Adjusted the ability to manually save by examining the bed in Chaya's room (very convenient!).
[*] Enhanced the effects when performing construction in Bakersfield.
[*] Adjusted the timing for unlocking the Knight's Base upgrade in Bakersfield.
[*] Adjusted the timing for unlocking recipe upgrades.
[*] Overall adjustments to the amount of coins and wood required for construction.
[*] Changed Bollio's bill amount from 1250 coins to 999 coins.
[*] Increased the material drop rate from the tutorial boss "Elite Stabby Crab".
[*] Adjusted to allow obtaining a special trophy by scoring 300 points in the Watersong Festival mini-game.
[*] Adjusted so that the long-range attack disappears when a long-range attacking monster has been defeated.
[*] Added an effect above Chaya's head when the cooldown after dashing is complete.
[*] Adjusted to allow dashing within the village (faster!).
[*] Added key assignments for opening the bag with key bindings.
[*] Adjusted the key assignment settings to allow assigning keys to operation buttons using key bindings.
[*] Removed the description text for the skill tree at the Knight's Base in the construction screen.
[*] Adjusted the explanation text for the status enhancement "Luck" to make it easier to understand.
[/list]
[h3]Battle Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted to reduce the damage taken from monsters when they are knocked back.
[*] Further reduced the damage reduction rate in casual mode.
[*] Adjusted the damage dealt to monsters in casual mode.
[*] Adjusted the calculation process for damage received in casual mode.
[*] Adjusted the strength variation range of monsters.
[*] Adjusted the durability of some monsters.
[*] Adjusted the falling motion of Shooty Crab’s bullets.
[*] Adjusted the hit range of some techniques of the Rock Golem.
[*] Shortened the cooldown for aerial dashes (stronger!).
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where an unintended screen would open at the end of the Watersong Festival mini-game.
[*] Fixed a bug where the effect of "Bollio's Construction" level 1 was not functioning in the construction screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where some monsters would stop fighting (no more pacifist monsters).
[*] Fixed a bug where "Patti King" unintentionally buffed itself.
[*] Fixed a bug where the character image displayed in the date change effect would not update until the game was restarted.
[*] Fixed a bug where the display related to recipe upgrades would be distorted under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed a bug where villagers could be interacted with while on moving platforms in the square.
[*] Fixed a bug where the effect of "Skill: Protective Strike" would not trigger under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed a bug where Effie would pretend to be busy even after the store closed.
[*] Fixed a bug where the settings "Screen Shake," "Display Damage," and "Display Buffs on Characters" were defaulted to off at initial startup.
[*] Fixed a bug where assigning keys to the mouse in key bindings would render operations impossible.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Summer Clam pulled by the whip drive would penetrate short platforms.
[*] Fixed a bug where the display would become distorted when opening and closing multiple UI's simultaneously.
[*] Fixed several localization-related bugs.
[/list]

Finally, we would like to express our deepest gratitude to everyone supporting Aeruta. During the Early Access period, we will be improving and adjusting existing content and new content based on your feedback. We welcome your honest opinions.

We hope you'll continue to support to make Aeruta the best game possible!

notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We greatly appreciate everyone's support for the "Aeruta" Early access version and 
the valuable suggestions and feedback provided after its release.

Based on various feedback, we have implemented the following updates:

[h2]Update Log for 2024/05/21[/h2]
[h3]Game Design & System Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added options in system settings to toggle screen shake, damage numbers, and buff displays above characters' heads.
[*] Added a tutorial for crossing platforms in the tutorial stage.
[*] Increased the overall size of the checkout mini-game interface.
[*] Improved the description of enhancement choices in the skill tree interface.
[*] Changed the description of luck in ability training, but the effect remains the same.
[*] The script for the Watersong mini-game now clearly states that the perfect score is 300.
[*] The gold trophy standard for the Watersong mini-game has been changed to 280, and the perfect score will be indicated in another way in the future.
[*] Adjusted the description of label bonuses in the daily interface.
[*] Adjusted the text size of daily ability bonuses in the calendar interface.
[*] The date in the upper right corner now indicates the season.
[*] The experience numbers in the development interface are now clearer.
[*] You can now exit key bindings using the cancel key.
[*] The message after auto-save completion no longer disappears.
[*] Villagers now make a sound when you achieve great success at checkout.
[*] Monster location hints are now displayed only after each room's monsters have appeared at least once.
[*] Adjusted the cutscene after defeating the boss in 1-3.
[*] The low health indicator is no longer shown during boss defeat cutscenes.
[*] Removed the numbers at the bottom left of Chaya's portrait.
[*] You can now eat bread during normal attacks.
[*] The healing bread in restrooms now restores at least 66% of health.
[*] Improved the stun ability of the martial Weapon Skill: Rolling Pin Cyclone.
[*] Reduced the tenacity of the Shooty Crab, its bullets now only bounce once, and the hitbox size has been reduced.
[*] Lowered the volume of the bullet hell attack used by the boss in 1-1.
[*] Reduced the natural anger increase rate of the boss in 1-3 and the increase rate when hitting Chaya, and also lowered the frequency of consecutive melee attacks (she should be a mage!).
[*] Adjusted some translation content.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the incorrect damage coefficient issue for Creamy Bunny Fountain and Bonk Puff.
[*] Fixed the issue where crab monsters sometimes abandoned combat during battle (they were too peaceful!).
[*] Fixed the issue where "did not eat any bread" appeared during adventure settlement before unlocking takeaway bread.
[*] Fixed the issue where the cursor moved to the far right in a short time when entering the adventure stage selection interface while moving.
[*] Fixed the issue where opening the backpack after selecting a stage in the adventure stage selection interface caused the game to freeze.
[*] Fixed the issue where bread received bonuses before unlocking the calendar.
[*] Fixed the issue where dropped items stick to ceilings or walls.
[*] Fixed the issue where lines in the bread list in the adventure preparation interface deepened over time.
[*] Fixed the issue where Effie could get stuck in the crafting animation during bread discount periods.
[*] Fixed the issue where customers complained about the lack of bread during bread discount periods.
[*] Fixed the issue where villagers got stuck in walking animation at the start of bakery events.
[*] Fixed the issue where the bonus numbers in parentheses were higher than the actual numbers in the management settlement interface.
[*] Fixed the issue where the bear claw attack range of the martial Weapon Skill: Bear's Wrath was larger than it appeared.
[*] Fixed the issue where damage reduction in easy mode also reduced healing.
[*] Fixed the issue where there was no sound when changing weapons in the skill tree interface.
[*] Fixed the issue where loading a save on the day the calendar was unlocked caused strange cutscenes.
[*] Fixed the issue where the dialogue box shifted when walking near Bollio while he was talking in town.
[*] Fixed the issue where starting a conversation from his left side in the Bollio debt repayment scenario caused the camera to shift and Bollio to face the wrong way.
[*] Fixed the issue where villagers' shadows remained after they disappeared in the scenario where villagers ask for help in 1-2.
[*] Fixed the issue where the dialogue for starting and finishing construction was reversed in Glass's construction interface.
[*] Fixed the issue where Patty King’s animation froze after turning around during the first encounter.
[*] Fixed the issue where task requirements still showed "pass through Leafy Path" when passing through Leafy Path on the day it was unlocked.
[*] Fixed the issue where there was no sound when selecting the chat button.
[*] Fixed the issue where the label color for Pedori bread ability: Spicy Tongue was incorrect.
[*] Fixed the issue where passages in stages opened and closed quickly after clearing a wave of monsters.
[*] Fixed the issue where elite stage items in the Stone Corridor showed as Giant Hammer Rock.
[/list]

Finally, we would like to express our deepest gratitude to everyone supporting "Aeruta". During the Early Access period, we will be improving and adjusting existing content and new content based on your feedback. We welcome your honest opinions.

To make "Aeruta" the best game possible, we hope you'll continue to support!

the valuable suggestions and feedback provided after its release.
